patch.value: Answer evidence coverage for declared question components

Require recursive answers to carry bounded source witnesses for every declared question component, with explicit unsupported and unknown outcomes. Acceptance: replay verifies every witness digest; omitted evidence cannot support an answer; validation performs no hidden model call. Add typed SDK and CLI surfaces, compact TOON/JSON, typed refusals with remedies, documentation and public-tracker no-git validation.

value.text: Overlap checked against the pinned CLI SDK query/aggregate contract, pm-context context-pack/context-handoff and receipt APIs, and pm-rlm aggregate/replay code.
